title: ValidationReport
description: Per-source acceptance decisions against a rubric for a sealed Research Report. See /artifacts/validation-report.md.

research_report_ref.description: Pointer to the exact sealed ResearchReport under judgment, including its digest for tamper-evident verification.

digest.description: Must match the referenced ResearchReport's sealed digest exactly.

rubric_id.description: Identifier of the versioned ValidationRubric applied to reach each verdict.

results.description: One entry per input evidence_id. Must cover 100% of the referenced ResearchReport's evidence_items.

evidence_id.description: Must exactly match an evidence_id from the referenced ResearchReport.

status.description: Verdict for this evidence item. needs_human escalates rather than forces a binary decision on high-impact ambiguity.

rationale.description: Required explanation, especially for any non-accepted status.

trust_tier.description: Calibrated confidence, independent from the source's advisory signal_tier.

examples.rationale: Primary-source technical documentation with maintained repository history; provenance verified.

results.rationale: Primary-source technical documentation with maintained repository history; provenance verified.
